literal_anchor: a man speaking dismissively toward a woman across her desk while gesturing toward her work documents
selection_logic: The sentence grounds three interlocking narrative elements: the male actor delivering derogatory remarks, the physical work being belittled, and the female colleague whose work is targeted. A three-panel progression cleanly establishes the interaction in s1, isolates the physical target of criticism in s2 without relying on textual markings or labels, and resolves in s3 on her emotional containment, giving final visual weight to the impact of the disparagement. A fourth shot showing outside observers was rejected as completely unsupported by the text.
